results.title: The certified rank hypothesis in row-5b form
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The hypothesis CR₃^5b is the following assertion. Let $n>0$ be squarefree with $n\equiv5\pmod8$. If $|\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_n)|=8$ and the determinant of Smith's row-5b matrix $M_{5b}$, built from the Legendre symbols of the primes of $n$, is $1$, then for every $(a,b)\in\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_n)$ the 2-covering $D_{a,b}$ of $C_n$ has a rational point; that is, every 2-Selmer class of $C_n$ comes from a rational point.

results.title: CR₃^5b implies CR₃^Sel
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Assume the certified rank hypothesis in row-5b form CR₃^5b. Then the certified rank hypothesis in Selmer form CR₃^Sel holds: for every squarefree $n>0$ with $n\equiv5\pmod8$ and $|\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_n)|=8$ such that some Selmer class has $|a|\equiv7\pmod8$, every Selmer class of $C_n$ comes from a rational point.

results.title: The certified rank hypothesis in Tian–Yuan–Zhang form
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The hypothesis CR₃^TYZ is the following assertion. Let $n$ be squarefree with $n\equiv5\pmod8$. If $|\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_n)|=8$ and the genus sum $T_{5b}(n)$ is $1$, then for every $(a,b)\in\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_n)$ the 2-covering $D_{a,b}$ of $C_n$ has a rational point; that is, every 2-Selmer class of $C_n$ comes from a rational point.

results.title: CR₃^TYZ implies CR₃^5b
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Assume the certified rank hypothesis in Tian–Yuan–Zhang form CR₃^TYZ. Then the certified rank hypothesis in row-5b form CR₃^5b holds: for every squarefree $n\equiv5\pmod8$ with $|\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_n)|=8$ and $\det M_{5b}=1$, every 2-Selmer class of $C_n$ comes from a rational point.
